fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Frenzy
fusions.desc: A swarm that deals 26 poison damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hackles Raised
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Apiary Watchdog
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
